facts.three-toast: Three women gather in a circle and raise their cups high over their heads in a toast.
facts.middle-back: The woman in the middle wears orange and has her back turned.
facts.wreaths: The women have flower and leaf ornaments on their heads.
facts.harvest: At their feet lie harvest goods such as pumpkins, grapes and other fruit.
facts.grapes-hand: The woman on the right holds a bunch of grapes in her other hand.
facts.blue-sky: The background is a blue sky.

glosses.middle-back: The middle one shows her back, giving a composition where the three face each other in a circle.

reversedGloss.excess: Playing and enjoying go too far, and the body and the tasks fall behind.
reversedGloss.waning: The cheer of the gathering cools and distance appears.
reversedGloss.blocked: The occasion to celebrate together is put off, or there is a feeling of not being invited.

misdescriptions.wrong: They have drunk too much and collapsed.
